messages:
mira: Quick note: starting 2026-04-01 were deprecating long-lived org service accounts. New requirement: use short-lived scoped delegation tokens for runtime and CI access. Rollout window: 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-14. See migration doc.

alina: Does this apply to sandbox and staging?

mira: Yes, all environments. Temporary exceptions via migration form.

paul: For CI, do we swap secrets for client id/secret? Any sample?

ken: For supported runners were providing a GH Action and a runner shim. Swap SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET -> DELEGATION_CLIENT_ID/SECRET and call token-exchange. Example in the FAQ.

devops-oncall: Automation plan: dry-run PRs 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC, apply 2026-04-03 05:00 UTC, enforcement 2026-04-08. Teams can opt-out by listing repos.

mira: Default token TTL 1h; request extended TTLs (up to 12h) through the form with justification.

security-bot: Scan snapshot for team infra-tools: 8 services with long-lived creds, 3 auto-PRs opened. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/migrations/infra-tools

alina: Will run migration-lint and add our repos to opt-in list. Thanks. :thumbsup:
